notes.title: Patch Update 03
notes.notes:
Patch update 03 

User interface fixes Power cards mainly. 
New Fonts used for all cards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761035/04870facdcf8452a215ea55c00680d3fb4c2bfed.png


Implemented a Leaderboard.
Ranking is only counted towards online P2P connection games. Each win will provide you with 10 Points. Every game you lose you get points deducted.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761035/bcb6dfabdc2e393f7eee8a9a1eae6672aa4b3d23.png

notes.title: Patch Update 02
notes.notes:
Patch update 02

Implemented Poison system.
Implemented Mana Resources System.
Added Damage to Opponents cards only Ability.
Added Taunt Cards.
Fixed UI Hover cards and Deck builder.
Have added P2P compatibility remember to tick LAN off to play P2P.

A total of 15 New cards have been added to this update.
